_note: Build-time package index: profile package-name → { path, adderExports? }. Profiles name packages; this maps each to its in-repo bundle for the BAKED build path (build.js --profile). The runtime/provisioned path resolves names via the registry instead (later phase). adderExports = the names adder code imports the lib by; ideally these move into each package's own manifest later. See spec_inbox/gcu-distributions-spec.md.
